title: Weekly Classes with Cone 10 Reduction Firing
source_quote: Fall session begins on September 16, online registration begind August 31! Weekly classes are all levels and include wheel and hand building techniques according to students needs. Decorating and glazing are also covered. Two clay bodies are available, toasty brown stoneware and white stoneware. Firing is cone 10 reduction & occur for 3 seasons, glaze firing is not available in winter.
evidence_sentence: The home page states weekly classes include cone 10 reduction firing occurring three seasons per year, excluding winter.
evidence_quote: Firing is cone 10 reduction & occur for 3 seasons
summary: Weekly classes for all levels include cone 10 reduction firing in three seasons (fall, spring, summer), with glazing and glaze firing available except in winter.
how_to_join: Online registration beginning August 31 for fall session
